title: Ogre: hex map, terrain, unit definitions
description: Game definition JSON + game wrapper foundation. 22x15 hex grid with hex_6 adjacency. Terrain types: clear, crater, rubble (movement cost via cell_properties). Unit types with attack/defense/range/movement: Infantry (1/1/1/2), Heavy Tank (4/3/2/3), Missile Tank (3/2/4/2), Howitzer (6/1/8/0), GEV (2/2/2/4+4), Command Post (0/1/0/0). Place standard Ogre Mk III: 1 main battery, 4 secondary batteries, 2 missiles, 8 AP guns, 45 tread units. Starting positions.
close_reason: Game definition + OgreGame wrapper with hex map, terrain, all unit types, Ogre Mk III subsystems, standard scenario. 18 tests.
